Tangent is sine over cosine, a ratio of entire functions

wolfram.note: FunctionMeromorphic only recognizes polynomials and a few named heads (e.g. Tan) directly; it doesn't have the general 'ratio/composition of meromorphic functions is meromorphic' closure rule that would cover x/(x^2+1), (x^2+1)/(x^2-1), etc.
